```python
PARAMS = {
    "gmid_in": (21.0, 14.0, 25.0),
    "L_in":    (2.0, 0.5, 4.0),
    "gmid_ld": (8.0, 5.0, 12.0),
    "L_ld":    (2.0, 0.5, 4.0),
    "Itail":   (7.0e-6, 5.5e-6, 8.0e-6),
    "gmid_t":  (11.0, 7.0, 15.0),
    "L_t":     (2.0, 1.0, 4.0),
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-12)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vdd = 1.8
    vcm = spec.get("vcm", 0.9)
    It = p["Itail"]
    Ib = It / 2

    # Tail mirror: the diode sinks IREF, and the tail copies it at the same L and gm/Id.
    mref = lut.size("n", p["gmid_t"], p["L_t"], iref, vds=0.6)
    vtail = 0.35
    mt = lut.size("n", p["gmid_t"], p["L_t"], It, vds=vtail)

    # Input pair
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_in"], p["L_in"], Ib, vds=0.9, vsb=vtail)
    vtail = vcm - m1.vgs
    mt = lut.size("n", p["gmid_t"], p["L_t"], It, vds=max(vtail, 0.15))
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_in"], p["L_in"], Ib,
                  vds=max(vdd - 0.9 - vtail, 0.2), vsb=max(vtail, 0.0))

    # PMOS mirror load
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_ld"], p["L_ld"], Ib, vds=0.9)
    vx = vdd - m3.vgs
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_in"], p["L_in"], Ib,
                  vds=max(vx - vtail, 0.2), vsb=max(vtail, 0.0))

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MREF", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mref)
    n.dev("MT", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mt)
    # vinp drives the M2 side (vout), so the output polarity is non-inverting.
    n.dev("M1", "x", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "vout", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "x", "x", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "vout", "x", "vdd", "vdd", m3)

    # Predictions
    gm1 = m1.gm
    gout = m1.gds + m3.gds
    A0 = gm1 / gout
    cpar = m1.cdd + m3.cdd + 2e-15
    ctot = cl + cpar
    ugbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * ctot)
    cx = 2 * m3.cgg + m1.cdd + m3.cdd
    fp2 = m3.gm / (2 * PI * cx)
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / fp2)) + math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / (2 * fp2)))
    slew = It / ctot
    power = vdd * (iref + It)
    # Swing in gain-10 inverting config: low end = tail + Vdsat1, high end = VDD - Vdsat4.
    vlow = vtail + m1.vdsat + 0.05
    vhigh = vdd - m3.vdsat - 0.05
    swing = vhigh - vlow
    tau = 1 / (2 * PI * ugbw)
    settle = 0.4 / slew + 4.6 * tau * 1.1
    rt = 1 / max(mt.gds, 1e-12)
    cmrr = A0 * 2 * m3.gm * rt
    psrr = A0
    kT = 1.38e-23 * 300
    th = math.sqrt(2 * 4 * kT * (2 / 3) / gm1 * (1 + m3.gm / gm1))
    noise_1k = th * 8  # flicker-dominated rough estimate; large input area keeps it bounded

    return n, {
        "gain_db": db(A0),
        "ugbw": ugbw,
        "pm": pm,
        "slew": slew,
        "power": power,
        "swing": swing,
        "settle": settle,
        "cmrr_db": db(cmrr),
        "psrr_db": db(psrr),
        "noise_1k": noise_1k,
    }
```
